hero.title: Build web apps with TypeScript and .meeko,
hero.lead: Meeko compiles typed components and hydrates server HTML. Its framework adds routes, data and API contracts for a complete app; the engine also works independently with Vite.

flow.title: One typed file.
flow.titleSoft: The server sends HTML and the browser only wires up what changes.
flow.typedBody: Script, template and styles together. TypeScript checks props, events, models and every template expression, with the error on the line of the .meeko file.
flow.signalsBody: update only the text or the attribute that changes. Lists keep their nodes by key.
flow.ssrBody: The server sends the complete page and the state of every signal; the browser hydrates it without painting it again. Also streaming, prerendering and client pages.
flow.figure: Isometric drawing: the Counter.meeko file goes to the server, which sends HTML; the browser hydrates it and receives the state of the signals.
flow.caption: Compile, render on the server, hydrate

deploy.title: Full-stack out of the box.
deploy.titleSoft: One standalone build per adapter and the same conformance suite for all four.
deploy.figure: Isometric drawing: meeko build with an adapter feeds four platforms, Node, Bun, Deno and Workers, inside the frame of a single conformance suite.
deploy.caption: One build, four targets
deploy.fullstackBody: File-based routes, layouts, server code in the page itself, typed API and RPC, sessions with revocation and WebSocket across instances.
deploy.platformsBody: One standalone build per adapter, checked by the same conformance suite. SemVer since 1.0, with an explicit stability policy.

showcase.title: Server data, browser interaction.
showcase.subtitle: A small end-to-end task.
showcase.lead: This list receives two tasks from the page's server block. The filter uses a signal in the browser. It is a real example on this site, with fixed data so you can try it without external services.
showcase.note: The page sends the tasks in its initial HTML; the button updates the list after hydration.

tools.title: Tools that see the runtime.
tools.titleSoft: The editor and DevTools show the real signals of each instance.
tools.caption: A rendering of the VS Code extension with meeko dev running: the value of each signal at the end of its line and in the hover
tools.editorBody: A language server with the diagnostics of meeko check, server/browser execution zones, signal hovers and live values from meeko dev.
tools.devtoolsBody: A tree of instances with their props and signals, a filterable timeline and a breakpoint per instance, inside the page or in a Chrome DevTools panel. It only exists in development.

start.title: Quick start.
start.titleSoft: One command creates the full-stack application; its scripts take it to production.
start.check: Generates the contracts and checks the types.
start.build: Client, server and prerendered pages; with --adapter, an output for Bun, Deno, Cloudflare or a static host.
